run_benchmark_video_plot: run the benchmark video plot script with --input and --output arguments to generate a performance plot
run_plot_benchmark_results: run plot_benchmark_results to generate a PNG plot from a CSV file of video decoding benchmark data
run_parse_args: run _parse_args to parse command line arguments for input CSV path and output plot path
review_plot_benchmark_results: review plot_benchmark_results which reads CSV benchmark data and generates QPS and CPU utilization plots per resolution
review_main: review the main entry point that parses args and calls plot_benchmark_results with input and output paths
